title: Especialista de Middleware (Produção)
description:
Atividades:

  • Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;
  • Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;
  • Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;
  • Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);
  • Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;
  • Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;
  • Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;
  • Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;
  • Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;
  • Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;
  • Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;
  • Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;
  • Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;
  • Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs.
  • Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;
  • Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;
  • Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;
  • Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;
  • Experiência em camada de observabilidade;
  • Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;
  • Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Billing, Ciclo de Receita, Ordering e Integrações;
  • Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;
  • Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;
  • Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);
  • Trabalho Remoto ou Híbrido.
  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

#VemPraENG!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a Customer Success Manager, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node.js Sênior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

Desenvolvedor Back-End para participar da refatoração de demandas estruturais, com foco na revisão de processos e sistemas de integração e disponibilização de dados, desenvolvendo a solução tecnológica considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e monitoria. Atender as necessidades das áreas de negócios, observando os padrões e as diretivas corporativas. Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações. Ter atitude de dono, aplicando visão forense e buscando as melhores práticas com foco nos resultados e entregas. Levantar estimativas para as soluções propostas, com bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização, proatividade e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


O que você precisa ter:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML) – Full-Time, Remote
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML)


Company: GTG LLC

Company Stage: Startup / Growth-Stage

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Senior (7+ years)


About the Role


GTG LLC is a growing startup building intelligent, scalable software solutions. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in Python and AI/ML engineering, who is also comfortable operating across the full stack.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, moving fast, and solving complex technical problems in an early-stage environment. You will work closely with founders and key stakeholders to design, build, and scale backend systems, AI-driven services, and modern web applications.


Key Responsibilities


 - Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python and frameworks such as Flask, Django, and FastAPI

 - Build and integrate AI/ML solutions, including model deployment, inference pipelines, and data processing workflows

 - Architect and maintain RESTful APIs with strong performance, scalability, and reliability

 - Collaborate on frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue

 - Contribute to overall system architecture, technical decisions, and engineering best practices

 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable deployments and high code quality

 - Work across the full product lifecycle, from early design and prototyping to production support

 - Identify technical gaps and proactively propose and implement solutions


Required Qualifications


 - 7+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer or similar senior-level role

 - C1 or higher English proficiency (mandatory) — strong verbal and written communication skills

 - Deep expertise in Python and backend development

 - Hands-on experience with Flask, Django, and/or FastAPI

 - Strong background in AI/ML engineering, including production-level model integration and deployment

 - Proficiency with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue)

 - Cloud experience with AWS or Azure (required)

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and production deployment workflows

 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment


Nice to Have


 - Experience with Java or C#, or proficiency in more than one backend programming language

 - Experience with GCP in addition to AWS or Azure

 - Prior experience working in early-stage or fast-moving startups


What We Offer


 - Opportunity to play a key technical role in a growing startup

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia.

Key Requirements:

• Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred)

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

• Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken)

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment

What We Offer:

• Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month)

• Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired

• Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months

• Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results

• Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia

• If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided

• Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team

• Support with relocation and integration in Europe

Key Responsibilities:

• Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.

• Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.

• Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.

• Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.

• Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.

• Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.

• Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).

• Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.

• Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The Opportunity We are an investment firm building a next-generation \"AI Operating System\" to power our deal flow and investor relations. We are looking for a Low-Code Engineer who can own our operations stack.


We aren't looking for someone to just connect simple triggers (Zapier-style). We need an architect who can build complex, multi-step workflows that fetch unstructured data (call transcripts, email history), process it via LLMs (Claude/GPT), and execute high-stakes communications with precision.


What You Will Build (General Scope)

  • AI-Driven Communications: Workflows that draft hyper-personalized emails to investors and clients by referencing historical data and context.
  • Intelligent Reporting Loops: Systems that periodically query our database to aggregate activity logs and generate strategic summaries for stakeholders.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensuring seamless data flow between our CRM (Attio), Database (Supabase), and Deal Room (Airtable).
  • Contextual RAG: Building logic that pulls specific past interactions (transcripts) to inform future AI outputs.

The Tech Stack

  • Orchestration: n8n (Primary requirement).
  • Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL).
  • CRM: Attio & Airtable.
  • AI: Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) & OpenAI APIs.

Who You Are

  • n8n Expert: You are comfortable using Code Nodes (JavaScript) to manipulate JSON data, handle error routing, and manage complex logic trees.
  • Data Literate: You are comfortable writing SQL queries (Supabase) to fetch, filter, and aggregate specific datasets (e.g., \"Fetch interactions from the last 48 hours\").
  • Prompt Engineer: You understand how to structure System vs. User prompts to prevent hallucinations and ensure strict formatting compliance.
  • Detail Oriented: We automate high-value interactions. You understand the importance of testing and \"kill-switches\" to prevent errors.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Java/Kafka
description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer – Java/Kafka

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract


We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience in Java distributed systems and stream-based processing to join our engineering team You will design build and operate backend services that handle high throughput workloads integrate with cloud platforms and support business critical applications

This role also involves working with Nodejs services CICD pipelines and modern infrastructure tooling including Kubernetes GitHub Actions AWS and GCP

Responsibilities Include

This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities including

Design implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Nodejs

Build and optimize message driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka

Develop scalable resilient APIs and backend services

Write clean maintainable and welltested code following industry best practices

Deploy monitor and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments

Work closely with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations

Participate in code reviews system design discussions and operational readiness efforts

Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure

Prototyping of new technologies to reduce cost and increase engineering velocity

Qualities Experience Were Seeking

We believe the right individual will have the following skills and experience to be successful in this role

A BS degree or higher in Engineering Computer Science or a related field is required 5 years of software engineering experience

Strong Java experience in backend or distributed systems environments

Hands-on experience with Kafka producers consumers partitions topics offsets stream processing etc

Proficiency in Nodejs for backend application development

Experience deploying and maintaining services running in Kubernetes

Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CICD

Handson experience with AWS andor GCP cloud platforms

Solid understanding of software design patterns system architecture and microservices principles

Experience working with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design performance considerations migrations

Strong debugging problem solving and communication skills

Excellent problem solving critical thinking and communication skills

Ability to work within a distributed team

Nice to have

VOD Streaming experience

Experience with React basic frontend integration work context management UI components

Exposure to infrastructureascode tools Terraform Helm etc

Monitoring observability tools Datadog New Relic

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Norte
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Norte



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Manager para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais

description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

  • Coordenar o processo de orçamento anual, assegurando prazos, premissas e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa.
  • Liderar a elaboração de forecasts periódicos, incluindo revisão de premissas e consolidação das informações das áreas de negócio.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards claros, consistentes e direcionados à liderança.
  • Atuar como parceiro das áreas operacionais, promovendo entendimento financeiro e suporte às decisões de negócio.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos, automação de rotinas e evolução dos indicadores financeiros.
  • Demais atividades conforme solicitação do Gestor Imediato.

Instrução:

  • Ensino Superior Completo Em Contabilidade, Administração ou Áreas afins.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

title: Instrutor de alunos
description:
Responsabilidades


•Acompanhar e desenvolver os Jovens Aprendizes que participarão do Programa Evoluir;

•Aplicar e acompanhar o conteúdo previsto junto aos aprendizes, bem como fazer o registro de presença, aulas estudadas e demais informações necessárias para o Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego;

•Adaptar e aplicar a metodologia de ensino às necessidades específicas dos aprendizes;

•Promover a participação ativa dos alunos através de atividades e metodologias de aprendizagem;

•Aplicar avaliações teóricas junto aos aprendizes;

•Acompanhar as aulas práticas junto ao monitor.


Requisitos


•Formação acadêmica de nível técnico ou superior;

•Domínio do Pacote Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel);

•Experiência prática em processos produtivos da indústria;

•Experiência como instrutor em cursos de formação será um diferencial.


Competências


•Habilidade para orientar e articular conhecimentos teóricos de forma clara e objetiva;

•Comunicação e abertura ao diálogo, incentivando a colaboração e o compartilhamento de experiências;

•Capacidade de promover um ambiente de aprendizagem inclusivo e colaborativo;

•Motivação para impulsionar o desenvolvimento profissional, acadêmico e pessoal dos aprendizes;

•Organização e gerenciamento de tempo.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.


The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.


As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!

Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (8+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Coordenador de Capital Humano
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Capital Humano para atuar no Brasil, com responsabilidade sobre a coordenação das operações de RH em diferentes unidades operacionais e interface direta com a liderança.


Sobre a Função

A posição exige atuação próxima aos times locais, garantindo conformidade legal, execução eficiente dos processos de RH e alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas.


Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar as operações de Capital Humano em múltiplas localidades no Brasil
  • Liderar e acompanhar um time de RH distribuído geograficamente
  • Garantir conformidade com a legislação trabalhista brasileira
  • Supervisionar processos de folha, benefícios, relações trabalhistas e ciclo de vida do colaborador
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) de RH para lideranças locais
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e assessorias externas
  • Realizar visitas periódicas às unidades operacionais


Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas afins
  • Experiência prévia em coordenação de RH no Brasil
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista
  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais ou industriais (desejável)
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Espanhol fluente


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido, com presença presencial conforme necessidade das operações.


Confidencialidade

Esta é uma vaga confidencial. Informações adicionais serão compartilhadas ao longo do processo seletivo.

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Engenheiro de Plataforma Kubernetes/Openshift Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos colaborando com uma empresa portuguesa de referência no setor do varejo , presente em Portugal e Espanha. Neste contexto, procuramos alguém com energia, responsabilidade e motivação para assumir a função de ENGENHEIRO DE PLATAFORMA KUBERNETES / OPENSHIFT , numa das iniciativas que estamos a conduzir com este cliente.

Neste projeto, a pessoa que se juntar ao time irá trabalhar remotamente com colegas da FCamara e do Cliente baseados em Portugal.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta pessoa terá como responsabilidade participar nos esforços de modernização da infraestrutura que suporta as aplicações de negócio do nosso Cliente.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, procuramos alguém com pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em funções semelhantes.

Você é a pessoa certa se atender estes requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Experiência prática com tecnologias de contêiner e orquestração, como Kubernetes;
  • Familiaridade com pipelines CI/CD utilizando Github Actions ou similares e ferramentas GitOps como Argo CD;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem, preferencialmente Azure ou GCP;
  • Experiência no uso de stacks de monitoramento e observabilidade, como Grafana e Prometheus;
  • Experiência em práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) e ferramentas como Terraform e Crossplane;
  • Experiência em Linux, TCP/IP, serviços de rede e segurança;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe com mentalidade de produto:
  • Desenvolver serviços de infraestrutura da plataforma;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de infraestrutura como produtos;
  • Automatizar o ciclo de desenvolvimento dos produtos de infraestrutura;
  • Certificação CKA ou Openshift (obrigatório).

Para além do conhecimento técnico, também esperamos que tenhas um perfil de colaboração e trabalho em equipe :

  • Capacidade para compreender os requisitos e as soluções técnicas
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Espírito crítico e foco na melhoria contínua
  • Forte orientação para a entrega e cumprimento de prazos e objetivos

Informações adicionais

Esta é uma posição Full Remote , atuando com equipes do Cliente baseados em Portugal e é específica para quem reside no Brasil (em qualquer cidade ou estado).

Esta posição está inserida num projeto de longa duração .

Idiomas: Nesta posição, o trabalho decorre em língua portuguesa . Inglês será valorizado, especialmente para interações em contexto internacional.

Modelo de Contratação: Temos flexibilidade no modelo de contratação. A nossa equipe de recrutamento fornecerá todos os detalhes e informações sobre o tipo de contrato, remuneração e benefícios, ajustados à tua localização e situação profissional.

Nacionalidade, Residência e Visto: Esta posição não contempla apoio, por parte da FCamara, na obtenção de visto ou autorização de residência para Portugal ou qualquer outro país.
